title: Speaker track (horizontal centre and head extent per frame)
what_it_does: Estimates, without any model, where the speaker's head is in every frame of a talking video: a median background of small YCbCr frames, the largest foreground blob, a skin-tone region as a second witness, then a smoothed track (deadband, critically damped pan with a speed limit). Writes track.json {fps, frames:[{t, cx, head_top, head_bottom, confidence, source}]} that shorts-from-long uses for a moving 9:16 crop and a face-safe text band.
when_to_use: Before cutting a 9:16 Short from a 16:9 talking-head video where the speaker moves sideways, so the fixed crop loses the face. Run it over the whole video once. Not a face detector: it fails on empty footage and is weak when the camera is handheld and the speaker never moves; check the crop by eye.
notes: Own code, zero dependencies. Method: classic background subtraction (temporal median) plus a YCbCr skin range; nothing is copied.
